Please report vulnerabilities privately to security@wrfcoin.com.
Do not include credentials, wallet recovery phrases, private keys, personal locations,
or private operator details. Search existing issues first.

## What happened?

Describe the expected and actual behavior.

## Reproduction

List the steps, repository revision, software versions, and testnet environment.
Include only sanitized logs or screenshots.

## Validation

Describe any local tests and their results.
